answer: A grove of seven sortition-drawn verifiers sends each identity nonces unannounced; replies are due in 60 seconds, signed over a secret state a hash steps forward after each answer. A farm draining many identities into one karst store, where separate accounts share one hidden chain, makes them answer a nonce identically; anyone can file the pair as proof. Each identity's 2,000-credit deposit stays frozen for life, thawing only on exit after 100 epochs; proof raises a plume flag on the root and slashes both. One honest agent freezes 2,000; 1,000 fakes freeze 2,000,000 on 1,000 stores at once.
